sections.title: Floating liverwort
sections.text: This small, non-vascular liverwort forms loose floating mats below the surface of still or slow-moving fresh water. Its flattened green body (thallus) forks repeatedly and has no true leaves or roots; narrow branches are generally under 1 mm wide, though measurements vary with growth form.

sections.title: Reproduction and use
sections.text: The aquatic form is usually sterile and reproduces mainly when thallus fragments grow. It is widely kept as an aquarium plant. No food use or human toxicity was established by the sources consulted.
